title: P104: a certified zero loan in the powered epoch and its paid limit
body:
## Construction and limit
The first paid tuple of the 268-factor floor-15 BIT source reads a fresh helper of productive rank 8²⁶⁸. This yields an identically zero first loan. A typed guard can omit its elementary FINISH on a deepest unborrowed, unaliased leaf while preserving ISSUE and owner return. On a bounded one-unit epoch, leaf actions drop 285,600 → 285,599 with all outputs equal for 5,772 independent bits. Lowering the floor to eight rejects the guard; forcing the skip changes 109 public rows. A nonconstant single-factor physical control checks the source and inverse. Even free deletion of all 13,824²⁶⁸ identified zero blocks leaves a normalized raw deficit above 10⁻⁴ at κ = 0.00389046.

## Sources and overlap
Main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; #8027 graph fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4; #8035 ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9; #8041 05f6172d4d9487090fa24c75137a7c60e6fcd67e. #8034 already bounds this support class. The contribution is the source-bound leaf construct, implementation experiment and failure controls. The isolated parent 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026 carries the shared #7257 CI prerequisite.

## Validation and next question
CPython 3.12: python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-certified-zero-epoch-leaf. All eight checks passed on the committed tree in 34.17 s. The hand-built one-unit test exposes the first authentic block to the epoch; it does not exercise the production 268-factor scheduler. The guard, flags and routing need a price and integration before a multiplier claim. Search for cancellation outside the existing support ceiling.

Ali Romman supplied the pinned graph and source, DreamingOfClouds the related #7852 toolkit, and Clear1nsight coordinated this follow-up with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
